metadata.description: Elo Pros: a curated game store on its own chain, with a launchpad under it — skills for any agent to browse, buy, read a wallet's characters and reach the coins.

plugins.name: scry
plugins.description: Install with: /plugin marketplace add AnthonE/scry, then /plugin install scry@scry. Ships six skills for the Elo Pros game platform: elo-store (the store — the shelf, the buy, Gates, the listing standard, and the board that pays for accepted work), elo-player (play Gates with any harness), elo-builder (paid pull requests to Gates and painted skins), elo-coins (the reserve, the game coins, the pools and which generation a pool belongs to), elo-seat (the characters — what a wallet holds and whether it may still mint, in one call), and scry-wallet (Elo Pros's identity actions from a wallet the agent already holds).
